branches_why: With 47 lines, branches are found by rule instead of by hand. Within 15:00–18:00, each pair of termini a line serves is its own Simutrans line when it has at least 6 trips (about 3 each way), a departure in the 16 o'clock hour, and no garage at either end. The busiest pair always counts. Smaller pairs (extensions, short workings, garage runs) are not separate lines, because “Also at” cannot change the route; their minutes are folded into the main row from the same terminus. Lines 49 and 54 end at Přívoz, sad Boženy Němcové and start back from Moravská Ostrava, Vozovna trolejbusů, the next stop, so those two count as one terminus. Where a line has two or more Simutrans lines, they are lettered A, B, C by trips.

41.why: Owner's choice (20 Oct 2026): model line 41 as it runs at 14:00, half-hourly from Hrabůvka, Poliklinika, alternating to Vratimov, náměstí (:22) and Vratimov, Kartonážka (:52); back from Kartonážka at :15 and from náměstí at :48. At 16:00 the timetable is sparse and irregular. By the shortest-wait rule it is one circuit: each bus does a náměstí trip and then a Kartonážka trip, waiting 15 min at Poliklinika before each. That needs 3 buses (180 min round), against 4 for two separate hourly lines with 45-min waits. Kartonážka is the loop beyond náměstí via Nová osada and Popinec.

hand_lines_rule: Hand-set ODIS lines (owner, 20 Oct 2026: 'You are good to go' on the bus schedule method check, pipeline/bus-schedule-method.md v2). Each line was read over the whole day at its core points; the afternoon anchor is the model hour. Slots: minutes for every 60, else 'H:MM' clock times (any one per slot). A leg's real departures come from the JDF trips of its 'lines'; a back leg of null is an empty, untimed return. These rules (whole-day core-point reading, no every 1440/720, at most 480) are for the regional (ODIS) lines only; local DPO lines are modelled at their afternoon peak, with their unique stops (owner, 20 Oct 2026). Depot runs are never modelled. mode 'add' keeps a line's automatic branches and adds these; 'window' is where the fit cell compares the slots with the real departures.

Which two comes from the plates on Tue 20 Oct 2026 (ODIS live map, session a4): the :05 buses went on as 441 at :31 (14:04, 16:04) or :46 (15:04), the :40 buses at :16 (14:39, 15:39), one :50 bus at :31; no :10 bus was seen going to 441 (14:09 went to 443). 441.note: 441's departures from Podlesí at :17 and :32 are the 442/441 circuit on the 442 card: those buses arrive on 442's :40 and :05 express trips (plates, Tue 20 Oct 2026). What is left of 441 is balanced: one bus an hour to Podlesí (:30, back :47) and the Havířov Město loop (:00, back from nemocnice :05). Buses arriving on 441 at Hranečník often go on as 440 (:12), as the plates show; 440 stays its own line. The night trips via Náměstí Republiky are outside the model hour.

534.note: 534 and 535 are one corridor (Step 5b): every 30 at Hranečník both ways, out :25 / :55 and in :03 / :33, all afternoon. Alone, 534 sends two an hour out and brings one back, and 535 the reverse. As two balanced hourly lines, 534 takes :55 (back from Karviná :20) and 535 :25 (back :01); they meet alternately at Orlová, Poruba, rest. Horník (:13 / :44 both ways). 534's own 13:25, 14:25 and 15:25 run in 535's :25 slot.

535.note: One corridor with 534 (see 534): 535 takes the :25 slot out of Hranečník and :01 back from Karviná. Before 16:25 that slot runs as 534 (13:25, 14:25, 15:25), counted here. 17:25 and 18:55 turn at Lutyně, autobusové nádraží; the Orlová, Poruba – Karviná trips run in the morning only.

387.note: In the afternoon 387 only runs out (14:45, 15:45); its trips back run in the morning. The return is an empty, untimed leg (Step 6), so the bus is back at Hranečník for the next :45.

383.note: No interval repeats over the whole day. In the afternoon the buses leave Hranečník 75 min apart (14:13, 15:28, 16:43); 75 does not divide 1440, so every 72 (method v2: any divisor of 1440) fits best: out within 3 min, back within 9 (16:47 against the 16:56 slot). On the To check list.

57.note: An exception the owner approved for this case (20 Oct 2026): local lines are otherwise modelled only at their afternoon peak. Three runs a day go from Kunčice, Nová huť garáže (a public stop, not a DPO depot) to Hulváky via Vítkovice, U chladičů: 6:08, 14:08, 22:13. They are the stop's only service and repeat every 480, a shift pattern. So they are their own Simutrans line every 480 from Nová huť at 14:08 (22:13 is 5 min after its 22:08 slot), and the bus returns empty, untimed; no trip runs back that way.
57.exception: owner approved for 57 only, 20 Oct 2026; further cases are asked with supporting info

hubs_why: Owner, 25 Oct 2026: 'similarly how we did the Hranečník, do the regional lines from Sad B.Němcové'. Unlike Hranečník (20 Oct, before the regional sheets existed), every ODIS line at sad B. Němcové was modelled, with its buses, on a regional sheet on 21–22 Oct. Lines shared between sheets are listed and linked, not repeated, and no bus is on two sheets (kb/rules/bus-sheets.md), so the section shows each line as its home sheet sets it, read from that sheet's derived data. Nothing here changes those sheets or the game.
regional_sheets_why: In build order. A line's home is the first of these sheets that models it (its derived schedule.json), else the first that lists it as not modelled (config.unmodelled, with the reason).
